item.title: CVE-2026-126302 · NLTK: Symlink escape in chat80.sql_query bypasses the pathsec data-root sandbox to read out-of-root SQLite databases

item.title: CVE-2026-128126 · AIOHTTP: Too many URL-encoded form fields block the event loop
item.description: ### Summary `Request.post()` had no limit on the number of fields in a URL-encoded form body. item.title: CVE-2026-128072 · @nuxt/webpack-builder and @nuxt/rspack-builder dev server serves built source to DNS rebinding pages
item.description: ### Summary When using the webpack or rspack builder, the dev server serves built client chunks to any request whose `Host` header matches its `Origin`/`Referer`, or that carries `Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin`. After a DNS rebinding attack both headers name the attacker's hostname, so a malicious page opened while `nuxt dev` is running can read `/_nuxt/*.js` and exfiltrate the app's source. This bypasses the same-origin check added for [GHSA-4gf7 | Producto: @nuxt/rspack-builder, @nuxt/webpack-builder | Corrección: 4.6.4

item.title: CVE-2026-129295 · mail-parser is vulnerable to polynomial ReDoS in email header parsing
item.description: ### Summary Two regular expressions used while parsing email headers backtrack polynomially on attacker-controlled input. Parsing a single small, well-formed email can consume minutes to hours of CPU, denying service to any process that parses untrusted mail. Both are reachable from an ordinary `parse_from_string()`, `parse_from_bytes()` or `parse_from_file()` call — no special API, option, or malformed structure is required by the victim. ### | Producto: mail-parser | Corrección: 4.6.1

item.title: CVE-2026-128129 · AIOHTTP: Unbounded buffering of data received during an upgrade request

item.title: CVE-2026-128124 · AIOHTTP: Event loop stall in add_domain() wildcard matching
item.description: ### Summary `Application.add_domain()` compiled each `*` in a host mask to `[^:]*`.
